notes: 02: capturePage collects only title+description; no favicon or preview/og:image collected. 03: save is immediate with no pre-save preview/edit step; only post-save editing (PUT) exists, so 'before saving' facet missing. 05: no DELETE endpoint or delete UI anywhere. 07: cards show title/description/tags/source(hostname) but no favicon icon. 12: searchText is built from title+description+source+note; the full url is not indexed (only hostname via 'source'), so url-path/query search fails. 20: no multi-select or bulk-action endpoints. 21: no filter-scope bulk apply. 22: list rendered in stored (newest-first) order only; no sort key/control. 23: note is stored and displayed via textContent (plain text), not rendered as markdown. 24: HTML snapshot captured/stored, but capturePage rejects non-text/html content, so the PDF download rule is unhandled. 25: snapshot/retry re-captures locally; no Internet Archive integration. 26/27/28: only 'read'/'done' statuses exist; no archive state, no archive-vs-delete distinction, no archived list. 29: no bundle/saved-filter feature. 30: no Netscape HTML import. 31: no export. 32: no user/display settings (default sort, items-per-page, font size).
